Container.Name: MKV Orchestrator
Container.Overview: MKV Orchestrator is a media operations console for scanning MKV/MP4 files, reviewing media and track metadata, renaming files from TVDB/TMDB metadata, mux/remux planning, track property edits, and library overview workflows. The container includes MKVToolNix and FFmpeg/FFprobe. Mount your Unraid shares into /media and optionally /downloads; configure provider API keys in the web Settings page or through the optional masked environment variables below.
Container.Description: Manage MKV and MP4 libraries from a browser with metadata scanning, provider-backed renaming, mux/remux planning, track property editing, and library workflows. MKVToolNix and FFmpeg/FFprobe are included.

Config.Name: Media Path
Config.Description: Primary media library path mounted into the container.

Config.Name: Downloads Path
Config.Description: Optional downloads or staging path mounted into the container.

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Persistent MKV Orchestrator settings, logs, and cache data.

Config.Name: Require Login
Config.Description: False grants full access to everyone who can reach MKVO, including reverse-proxy visitors. True requires administrator sign-in. Recreate the container after changing login settings.

Config.Name: Administrator Username
Config.Description: Case-sensitive administrator username. Blank uses admin. Credentials are preserved while login is disabled.

Config.Name: Administrator Password
Config.Description: Administrator password. Leave blank to generate and preserve a password in /config/admin-password.txt. Retrieve it privately from that file; it is never shown in logs.

Config.Name: Media Root
Config.Description: Default root used by the Dashboard browser.

Config.Name: Source Roots
Config.Description: Additional named source roots. /media is added automatically; use name=/container/path entries separated by commas.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns files created by MKVO. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns files created by MKVO. Unraid default: 100 (users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask for new files.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Enable only when accessing MKVO over HTTPS. Leave false for plain HTTP LAN access.

Config.Name: Edit Workers
Config.Description: Maximum concurrent mkvpropedit track property edits.

Config.Name: TVDB API Key
Config.Description: Optional container-managed TVDB API key. It appears as configured in MKVO Settings after the container restarts, but its value remains masked.

Config.Name: TVDB PIN
Config.Description: Optional container-managed TVDB subscriber PIN. It appears as configured in MKVO Settings after the container restarts, but its value remains masked.

Config.Name: TMDB API Key
Config.Description: Optional container-managed TMDB API key. It appears as configured in MKVO Settings after the container restarts, but its value remains masked.
